details: The US economy added a significantly lower-than-expected 29,000 jobs in September, falling short of the anticipated 90,000, and the unemployment rate edged up to 4.2%. This weaker employment data has led to a notable increase in market expectations for the Federal Reserve to pause interest rate hikes, with prediction markets now indicating an 85% probability of a pause in October. This shift in monetary policy expectations has spurred a "risk-on" rally across financial markets, contributing to Bitcoin climbing to approximately $87,000.
title: Weaker US Jobs Report Boosts Bitcoin, Fed Pause Bets

details: SEC Chairman Paul Atkins acknowledged that the cryptocurrency market has evolved from a "niche curiosity into a multi-trillion-dollar asset class" and stated that existing regulations have not kept pace. In response, the SEC has proposed a new regulatory framework for crypto asset custody. This framework aims to provide a clearer and compliant pathway for investment advisers and regulated funds to hold digital assets, including provisions that could allow self-custody under certain conditions. Atkins emphasized that these efforts are part of a broader strategy to modernize regulatory frameworks and establish the United States as a global leader in crypto.
title: SEC Chair Calls Crypto Multi-Trillion Asset Class, Proposes New Custody Rules

details: Robinhood announced plans to introduce 24/7 trading for select US stocks and Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs), including weekends, pending regulatory approval. This initiative seeks to capitalize on the high demand for extended trading hours, noting that approximately 70% of Robinhood's current trading volume occurs during off-market times. The company plans to leverage blockchain technology to enhance efficiency by potentially reducing delays in clearing and settlement processes. This move, if successful, could diminish one of Bitcoin's historical unique advantages: its continuous trading availability.
title: Robinhood to Offer 24/7 Tokenized Stock Trading, Challenges Crypto's Edge
